items.stem: Why is it risky to make hiring and promotion decisions on 'gut feel' with no documentation?

options.text: It invites unfairness and gives no defensible record of the decision
options.rationale: Correct: documentation supports fairness, consistency and due process.

options.text: Documentation is only needed for firing
options.rationale: Fair, recorded process matters across people decisions.

options.text: Gut feel is the most reliable basis for decisions
options.rationale: Unstructured judgement is prone to bias.
Records support, rather than reduce, fairness.

items.explanation: Correct: documentation supports fairness, consistency and due process.

items.stem: Which practices strengthen performance management? (Select TWO)

options.text: Giving timely, specific feedback throughout the year
options.rationale: Correct: regular feedback is more effective than a single annual event.

options.text: Linking individual goals to team or business objectives
options.rationale: Correct: alignment makes goals meaningful and measurable.

options.text: Saving all feedback for one annual review
options.rationale: Delayed feedback loses relevance and impact.

options.text: Keeping goals vague so they are easy to meet
options.rationale: Vague goals cannot be assessed or developed against.

items.explanation: Correct: regular feedback is more effective than a single annual event.

items.stem: An employee raises a grievance informally. What is a fair first step for HR?

options.text: Follow a consistent, documented process to understand and address it
options.rationale: Correct: a fair, recorded process protects everyone and ensures due process.

options.text: Ignore it unless it is put in writing with witnesses
options.rationale: Dismissing a concern undermines fairness and trust.

options.text: Immediately discipline the person complained about
options.rationale: Acting before investigation denies due process.

options.text: Tell the employee to resolve it entirely alone
options.rationale: HR has a role in ensuring fair handling.

items.explanation: Correct: a fair, recorded process protects everyone and ensures due process.
